[[File:Kota Tinggi Town Square.jpg|thumb|Kota Tinggi]]
'''Kota Tinggi''' is a town in Kota Tinggi District, [[Johor]], [[Malaysia]]. Kota Tinggi is known as a historical town because the Sultanate of Johor was established there. Many historical tombs are found here  including the Sultan Mahmud Mangkat Di Julang Mausoleum, Makam Bendahara Tun Habib Abdul Majid and Makam Tauhid in Kampung Makam. 

==Get in==
 
===By plane===
The nearest airport with commercial flights is the Senai International Airport in [[Senai]], which is well-connected to the rest of Malaysia, including several daily flights to [[Kuala Lumpur]] by AirAsia. An alternative option would be to fly into [[Singapore]], which is better connected internationally than Johor Bahru, though with the added hassle of having to pass through customs and immigration twice.

===By bus===
There are frequent buses (Maju 227, Causeway Link 6B, Transit Link 41) between downtown [[Johor Bahru]]'s Jalan Wong Ah Fook (the bus stop is opposite City Square) and Kota Tinggi's bus terminal at Jalan Niaga Utama. The Maju 227 bus originates and terminates at Johore Bahru's Larkin Bus Terminal. Causeway Link no. 66 bus plies between Larkin Bus Terminal and Kota Tinggi. The average frequency of the Maju 227 bus is every 15 minutes and the one-way fare between City Square and Kota Tinggi is RM4.80. The journey takes about 1 hour or more, depending on the bus number and traffic conditions. Generally, buses with "Kota Tinggi" in large letters, and without other smaller stops written on the front, tend to travel faster.

There are non-stop Mara Liner coach services four times a day from Johor Bahru's Larkin Bus Terminal to Kota Tinggi at 10:30AM, 1PM, 5PM and 10PM, en route to Bandar Penawar. The one-way fare is RM 4.00.

==Do==
Take a cruise to see the fireflies amongst the mangroves is a good idea.The fare is RM20 per person and the cruise lasts about 45 minutes.
[[File:Kota Tinggi Firefly Park 02.jpg|thumb|Kota Tinggi Firefly Park]]
* {{do
| name=Kota Tinggi Firefly Park | alt=Taman kelip-kelip | url=https://www.facebook.com/ktfireflypark | email=
| address=Jalan Kota Tinggi,81900,Johor | lat=1.727251 | long=103.911404 | directions=
| phone= | tollfree=
| hours= | price=
| image=Kota_Tinggi_Firefly_Park_02.jpg | wikidata=Q89502910
| lastedit=2020-03-05
| content=Johor Bahru Kota Tinggi river is a rare breeding ground and habitats for fireflies. Thousands of fireflies spread over the banks of the river and correspond to the stars, creating a unique landscape. It is an attraction not to be missed when traveling to Johor.
}}
* There are '''many''' beaches along the coastal part of Kota Tinggi. The most popular beaches are Tanjung Balau, Desaru and Batu Layar ('sail rock'), which are 58 km, 55 km, and 62 km from Kota Tinggi town respectively. Chalets and hotels offering reasonable rates can easily be found along the beach.
* '''Teluk Sengat''', 25 km east of Kota Tinggi town, is a village visited by tourists for its seafood.
